summary.text: Sandy Nurse has represented the 37th District on the New York City Council since 2022, covering Bushwick, Brownsville, Cypress Hills, Cityline and East New York in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she is in her final term and chairs the Committee on Civil and Human Rights.

paragraphs.text: As Sanitation Chair, according to her Council biography, Nurse shepherded the Zero Waste Act, which included curbside composting and a goal of zero waste by 2030.
It credits her with the Public Solar Bill, with securing a $390 million sewer upgrade to address flooding in Bushwick, and with the Rent Transparency Act.
It also says she helped raise the minimum wage for Instacart workers and secured additional protected time off for over 4 million New York City workers.
